traces.reply: Hi Wrenfield Payroll, thanks for the details and the logs. The signature is an HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body, and your code is computing it from JSON.stringify(req.body) after express.json() has parsed the body. Configure the webhook route to give you the raw bytes (for example express.raw({type: 'application/json'}) on that route) and compute the HMAC over that, using a constant-time comparison.
